turns.question: What revenue did customers who signed up in August or September 2024 bring in on 1 October 2026?
turns.answer: Customers who signed up in August or September 2024 brought in 4,020.00 EUR of revenue (August 2024 signup cohort 1,695.00 EUR, September 2024 cohort 2,325.00 EUR), covering their non-cancelled orders placed up to 1 October 2026. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
